parameters.name: CompanyLimitCount
parameters.description: The registration limit for corporate devices.

parameters.name: CompanyLimitType
parameters.description:
The registration limit type for corporate devices. Valid values:

- **Unlimited**: No limit.

- **LimitAll**: Limits the total number of devices.

- **LimitDiff**: Limits devices by terminal type.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the device registration policy. The description can be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and spaces.

parameters.name: MatchMode
parameters.description:
The matching target type of the policy. Valid values:

- **UserGroupAll**: Associates with all users.

- **UserGroupNormal**: Associates with specific user groups.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the device registration policy. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PersonalLimitCount
parameters.description: The registration limit for personal devices.

parameters.name: PersonalLimitType
parameters.description:
The registration limit type for personal devices. Valid values:

- **Unlimited**: No limit.

- **LimitAll**: Limits the total number of devices.

- **LimitDiff**: Limits devices by terminal type.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the device registration policy. You can obtain the ID by calling one of the following operations:

- [ListRegistrationPolicies](~~ListRegistrationPolicies~~)

- [GetRegistrationPolicy](~~GetRegistrationPolicy~~)

- [CreateRegistrationPolicy](~~CreateRegistrationPolicy~~)

- [UpdateRegistrationPolicy](~~UpdateRegistrationPolicy~~)

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The priority of the device registration policy. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. The value 0 indicates the highest priority, and 99 indicates the lowest priority.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the device registration policy. Valid values:

- **Enabled**

- **Disabled**

parameters.name: UserGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of user groups. This parameter is required when MatchMode is set to **UserGroupNormal**. A policy can be associated with up to 100 user groups.

parameters.name: Whitelist
parameters.description: The list of whitelisted users for the device registration policy. You can add up to 1,000 usernames.
